series.name: Sharp PSR series display codes (E and P)
series.notes: SHARP(CHINA) AY-X9PSR / AE-X9PSR / AY-X12PSR / AE-X12PSR service manual (R32 split). Codes appear on the indoor digital LED. Phase A retail checks (priceoye, daraz, ledmart, laptab, yasir, amazon.pk) did not show a PSR-suffixed SKU in Pakistan, so this file is model-scoped, not brand-wide.

title.ur: Indoor aur outdoor ka communication fault

meaning.en: The indoor and outdoor boards cannot exchange data, so the unit stops.
meaning.ur: Indoor aur outdoor boards data aapas mein nahi kar pate, is liye unit band ho jati hai.

causes.en: Inter-unit communication wire (CN5) is loose or missing.
causes.ur: Inter-unit communication wire (CN5) dheeli ya gayab hai.

causes.en: Outdoor power source board or IPM board is not responding.
causes.ur: Outdoor power source board ya IPM board jawab nahi de raha.

causes.en: Wrong L/N correspondence between indoor and outdoor.
causes.ur: Indoor aur outdoor mein L/N ke mapping ghalat hain.

solutions.en: Check that L and N correspond on both units and refit the communication wire.
solutions.ur: Dono units par L aur N ke mapping check karein aur communication wire wapas lagayein.

solutions.en: Measure the voltage pulses on outdoor terminal N to 1, replace the board that fails.
solutions.ur: Outdoor terminal N se 1 par voltage pulses naapein, jo board fail usse badlein.

solutions.en: Replace the indoor main PCB or outdoor power source board as diagnosed.
solutions.ur: Diagnosis ke mutabik indoor main PCB ya outdoor power source board badlein.

source.title: Sharp AY-X9PSR Service Manual, Troubleshooting Guide (Display E0, E5)

meaning.en: Communication between the outdoor power source board and the intelligent power module has broken.
meaning.ur: Outdoor power source board aur intelligent power module ke darmiyan communication toot gaya.

causes.en: Communication wire CN5 between the two outdoor boards is loose.
causes.ur: Dono outdoor boards ke darmiyan CN5 wire dheeli hai.

causes.en: Intelligent power module is not working.
causes.ur: Intelligent power module kaam nahi kar raha.

causes.en: Outdoor power source board has failed.
causes.ur: Outdoor power source board kharab ho gaya hai.

solutions.en: Check and reseat CN5; both board indicators should flash together at 1 s on / 1 s off.
solutions.ur: CN5 check karke wapas lagayein; dono board indicators 1 second on / 1 second off par flash hona chahiye.

solutions.en: Replace the intelligent power module if its indicator stays dead.
solutions.ur: Uska indicator band rahe to intelligent power module badlein.

solutions.en: Replace the outdoor power source board if its indicator stays dead.
solutions.ur: Outdoor power source board ka indicator band rahe to use badlein.

source.title: Sharp AY-X9PSR Service Manual, Troubleshooting Guide (Display EC)

meaning.en: The indoor room temperature thermistor is drifted, open or shorted.
meaning.ur: Indoor room temperature thermistor ki reading shift, open ya short hai.

causes.en: IRT connector on CN6 is loose in its slot.
causes.ur: CN6 par IRT connector slot mein dheela hai.

causes.en: Sensor resistance is out of the 25C / 5k spec.
causes.ur: Sensor ka resistance 25C / 5k spec se bahar hai.

solutions.en: Refit the CN6 (RT, IPT) connector and measure the sensor.
solutions.ur: CN6 (RT, IPT) connector wapas lagayein aur sensor naapein.

solutions.en: Replace the room temperature sensor if the resistance has drifted.
solutions.ur: Resistance shift ho to room temperature sensor badlein.

solutions.en: Replace the indoor control board if the sensor is good.
solutions.ur: Sensor sahi ho to indoor control board badlein.

source.title: Sharp AY-X9PSR Service Manual, Troubleshooting Guide (Display E1 or E2)

meaning.en: The indoor coil thermistor reading is abnormal, so coil protection takes over.
meaning.ur: Indoor coil thermistor ki reading ghalat hai, is liye coil protection ne control le liya.

causes.en: IPT connector loose on the indoor board.
causes.ur: IPT connector indoor board par dheela hai.

causes.en: Sensor open, shorted or drifted.
causes.ur: Sensor open, short ya drift ho gaya hai.

solutions.en: Refit the CN6 connector and measure the sensor at 25C / 5k.
solutions.ur: CN6 connector wapas lagayein aur sensor 25C / 5k par naapein.

solutions.en: Replace the indoor pipe sensor if out of spec.
solutions.ur: Spec se bahar ho to indoor pipe sensor badlein.

solutions.en: Replace the indoor control board if the sensor measures fine.
solutions.ur: Sensor sahi nikle to indoor control board badlein.

source.title: Sharp AY-X9PSR Service Manual, Troubleshooting Guide (Display E1 or E2)

meaning.en: The outdoor coil thermistor is open, shorted or drifted.
meaning.ur: Outdoor coil thermistor open, short ya drift ho gaya hai.

causes.en: Sensor plug not seated on CN1/CN2 of the outdoor board.
causes.ur: Sensor ka plug outdoor board ke CN1/CN2 par laga nahi.

causes.en: Sensor resistance is out of 25C / 5k.
causes.ur: Sensor ka resistance 25C / 5k se bahar hai.

solutions.en: Refit the outdoor sensor connectors and measure resistance.
solutions.ur: Outdoor sensor connectors wapas lagayein aur resistance naapein.

solutions.en: Replace the outdoor coil sensor if drifted or open.
solutions.ur: Drift ya open ho to outdoor coil sensor badlein.

solutions.en: Replace the outdoor power source board if sensors test fine.
solutions.ur: Sensors sahi nikle to outdoor power source board badlein.

source.title: Sharp AY-X9PSR Service Manual, Troubleshooting Guide (Display E3, E7, E8)

meaning.en: The board's model/parameter configuration does not match the assembled unit.
meaning.ur: Board ki model/parameter configuration assembled unit se match nahi karti.

causes.en: Model selection jumper or settings are wrong.
causes.ur: Model selection jumper ya settings ghalat hain.

causes.en: Board replaced without reprogramming the model data.
causes.ur: Board badalte waqt model data dobara set nahi kiya.

causes.en: IPM board or outdoor power board fault behind the flag.
causes.ur: Flag ke peeche IPM board ya outdoor power board kharab hai.

solutions.en: Check the model configuration jumpers against the nameplate.
solutions.ur: Model configuration jumpers ko nameplate se milayein.

solutions.en: Check the IPM board indicators and DC bus (about 310V) as per the chart.
solutions.ur: Chart ke mutabik IPM board ke indicators aur DC bus (kareeb 310V) check karein.

solutions.en: Replace the indoor main PCB or outdoor power board if configuration is correct.
solutions.ur: Configuration sahi ho to indoor main PCB ya outdoor power board badlein.

source.title: Sharp AY-X9PSR Service Manual, Troubleshooting Guide (Display E0, E5)

meaning.en: The indoor fan motor is not running correctly.
meaning.ur: Indoor fan motor theek se nahi chal raha.

causes.en: Cross-flow fan blade is rubbing or blocked.
causes.ur: Cross-flow fan blade ragad kha raha ya block hai.

causes.en: Motor plugs CN3/CN4 are loose on the indoor main PCB.
causes.ur: Motor ke plugs CN3/CN4 indoor main PCB par dheele hain.

causes.en: Fan capacitor value is wrong or the capacitor has failed.
causes.ur: Fan capacitor ki value ghalat hai ya capacitor kharab hai.

solutions.en: Adjust the fan blade so it spins smoothly and refit CN3/CN4.
solutions.ur: Fan blade ko smooth ghoomne ke liye adjust karein aur CN3/CN4 lagayein.

solutions.en: Check the capacitor value and replace it if weak.
solutions.ur: Capacitor ki value check karein, kamzor ho to badlein.

solutions.en: Replace the indoor main PCB if everything above checks out.
solutions.ur: Upar wali sab checks sahi hon to indoor main PCB badlein.

source.title: Sharp AY-X9PSR Service Manual, Troubleshooting Guide (Display E6)

meaning.en: The outdoor ambient temperature sensor reading is out of range.
meaning.ur: Outdoor ambient temperature sensor ki reading range se bahar hai.

causes.en: Sensor plug not seated on the outdoor board.
causes.ur: Sensor ka plug outdoor board par laga nahi.

causes.en: Sensor open, shorted or drifted.
causes.ur: Sensor open, short ya drift ho gaya hai.

solutions.en: Refit the connector and measure the sensor at 25C / 5k.
solutions.ur: Connector wapas lagayein aur sensor ko 25C / 5k par naapein.

solutions.en: Replace the outdoor air temperature sensor.
solutions.ur: Outdoor air temperature sensor badlein.

solutions.en: Replace the outdoor power source board if the sensor is good.
solutions.ur: Sensor sahi ho to outdoor power source board badlein.

source.title: Sharp AY-X9PSR Service Manual, Troubleshooting Guide (Display E3, E7, E8)

meaning.en: The compressor discharge temperature sensor is open, shorted or drifted (25C / 20k).
meaning.ur: Compressor discharge temperature sensor open, short ya drift ho gaya hai (25C / 20k).

causes.en: Sensor plug not seated on CN2 of the outdoor board.
causes.ur: Sensor ka plug outdoor board ke CN2 par laga nahi.

causes.en: Sensor resistance is not 20k at 25C.
causes.ur: Sensor ka resistance 25C par 20k nahi hai.

solutions.en: Refit the connector and measure the discharge sensor.
solutions.ur: Connector wapas lagayein aur discharge sensor naapein.

solutions.en: Replace the discharge temperature sensor.
solutions.ur: Discharge temperature sensor badlein.

solutions.en: Replace the outdoor power source board if the sensor is in spec.
solutions.ur: Sensor spec mein ho to outdoor power source board badlein.

source.title: Sharp AY-X9PSR Service Manual, Troubleshooting Guide (Display E3, E7, E8)

meaning.en: The intelligent power module failed; P0 or P9 shows first and then changes to E9.
meaning.ur: Intelligent power module kharab ho gaya; pehle P0 ya P9 nazar aata hai phir E9 ban jata hai.

causes.en: Compressor connection is wrong or the compressor is faulty.
causes.ur: Compressor ki connection ghalat hai ya compressor kharab hai.

causes.en: IPM is not fixed tightly to the radiator fins or silicone is uneven.
causes.ur: IPM radiator fins par mazbooti se nahi laga ya silicone barabar nahi hai.

causes.en: System pressure is too low or too high.
causes.ur: System pressure bohat kam ya bohat zyada hai.

solutions.en: Check compressor wiring order (red, white, blue on U, V, W) and refit.
solutions.ur: Compressor ki wiring order (U, V, W par red, white, blue) check karke wapas lagayein.

solutions.en: Re-screw the IPM onto the fins with even silicone and check ventilation.
solutions.ur: IPM ko barabar silicone ke sath fins par kas kar lagayein aur hawa check karein.

solutions.en: Correct the refrigerant charge, then replace the IPM if the fault stays.
solutions.ur: Gas charge theek karein, fault rahe to IPM badlein.

notes.en: Manual sequence: unit first displays P0 or P9, then changes to E9. P0 and P9 also have their own chart/troubleshooting rows, so they stay separate entries and are not listed as aliases here.
notes.ur: Manual ke mutabiq pehle P0 ya P9 nazar aata hai phir E9 ban jata hai. P0 aur P9 ke chart/troubleshooting mein apni alag rows hain, is liye wo alag entries rakhi gayi hain aur yahan alias nahi.

source.title: Sharp AY-X9PSR Service Manual, Troubleshooting Guide (Display E9)

title.ur: Outdoor fan motor (DC) kharab ho gayi

meaning.en: The outdoor DC fan motor did not start or lost feedback.
meaning.ur: Outdoor DC fan motor start nahi hui ya feedback kho diya.

causes.en: Outdoor fan motor or its connector has failed.
causes.ur: Outdoor fan motor ya uska connector kharab hai.

causes.en: Fan drive circuit on the outdoor board is faulty.
causes.ur: Outdoor board par fan drive circuit kharab hai.

solutions.en: Power off and check that the fan blade spins freely.
solutions.ur: Power band karke fan blade free ghoomta hai ya nahi dekhein.

solutions.en: Check the fan motor connector and replace the motor if open.
solutions.ur: Fan motor ka connector check karein, open ho to motor badlein.

solutions.en: Replace the outdoor power source board if the motor tests fine.
solutions.ur: Motor sahi nikle to outdoor power source board badlein.

source.title: Sharp AY-X9PSR Service Manual, Ch.6 Chart (indoor failure codes)

meaning.en: The board could not read compressor current correctly through its current sensor.
meaning.ur: Board ne current sensor ke zariye compressor ka current theek se padha nahi.

causes.en: Current sensor on the outdoor power board has failed.
causes.ur: Outdoor power board par current sensor fail ho gaya hai.

causes.en: Refrigerant leak has led to abnormal running current.
causes.ur: Gas leak ki wajah se running current abnormal ho gaya hai.

solutions.en: Check for refrigerant leakage and repair the leak point.
solutions.ur: Gas leak check karke leak wali jagah theek karein.

solutions.en: Replace the outdoor power source board if there is no leak.
solutions.ur: Leak na ho to outdoor power source board badlein.

source.title: Sharp AY-X9PSR Service Manual, Troubleshooting Guide (Display EA)

meaning.en: Stored data on the board's EEPROM could not be read or verified.
meaning.ur: Board ke EEPROM par save data padha ya verify nahi hua.

causes.en: EEPROM chip failed.
causes.ur: EEPROM chip fail ho gaya hai.

causes.en: Data corrupted after a power interruption.
causes.ur: Power cut ke baad data kharab ho gaya.

solutions.en: Power cycle from the breaker for 10 seconds and retest.
solutions.ur: Breaker se 10 second power cycle karke dobara test karein.

solutions.en: Replace the board if the code does not clear.
solutions.ur: Code clear na ho to board badlein.

source.title: Sharp AY-X9PSR Service Manual, Troubleshooting Guide (Display EE)

title.ur: Compressor top ka temperature switch kharab

meaning.en: The shell temperature switch on top of the compressor operated or its circuit is open.
meaning.ur: Compressor ke upar wala shell temperature switch operate ho gaya ya uski line khuli hai.

causes.en: CN3 switch wires are not plugged into the outdoor board.
causes.ur: CN3 switch ki wires outdoor board par nahi lagi hain.

causes.en: Compressor is genuinely overheating (low gas, poor ventilation).
causes.ur: Compressor sach mein overheat ho raha hai (gas kam, hawa kam).

causes.en: The top temperature switch itself has failed.
causes.ur: Upar wala temperature switch hi kharab hai.

solutions.en: Refit CN3 and check the U, V, W wiring order (red, white, blue).
solutions.ur: CN3 wapas lagayein aur U, V, W ka order (red, white, blue) check karein.

solutions.en: Add refrigerant if pressure is low and clear anything blocking outdoor airflow.
solutions.ur: Pressure kam ho to gas bharayein aur outdoor ki hawa ki rukawat hataayein.

solutions.en: Replace the shell temperature switch, then the outdoor board if needed.
solutions.ur: Shell temperature switch badlein, zaroorat ho to outdoor board badlein.

source.title: Sharp AY-X9PSR Service Manual, Troubleshooting Guide (Display EP)

meaning.en: The outdoor board cannot sense the mains voltage through its sampling circuit.
meaning.ur: Outdoor board apne sampling circuit se mains voltage sense nahi kar raha.

causes.en: Voltage sampling circuit on the outdoor power board has failed.
causes.ur: Outdoor power board ka voltage sampling circuit fail ho gaya hai.

causes.en: Supply is outside the protector range.
causes.ur: Supply protector range se bahar hai.

solutions.en: Confirm the supply is within the unit's protector range.
solutions.ur: Supply unit ki protector range ke andar hai, confirm karein.

solutions.en: Replace the voltage sampling circuit on the outdoor power source board.
solutions.ur: Outdoor power source board ka voltage sampling circuit badlein.

source.title: Sharp AY-X9PSR Service Manual, Troubleshooting Guide (Display EU)

meaning.en: The outdoor intake (ambient) temperature sensor reading is abnormal.
meaning.ur: Outdoor intake (ambient) temperature sensor ki reading ghalat hai.

causes.en: Sensor open, shorted or drifted.
causes.ur: Sensor open, short ya drift ho gaya hai.

causes.en: Connector not seated on the outdoor board.
causes.ur: Connector outdoor board par laga nahi.

solutions.en: Check the connector and measure the sensor at 25C / 5k.
solutions.ur: Connector check karein aur sensor ko 25C / 5k par naapein.

solutions.en: Replace the intake temperature sensor, then the outdoor board.
solutions.ur: Intake temperature sensor badlein, phir outdoor board badlein.

source.title: Sharp AY-X9PSR Service Manual, Ch.6 Chart (indoor failure codes)

title.ur: Module protection on ho gaya (hardware control)

meaning.en: Hardware-level module protection fired; the display then changes to E9.
meaning.ur: Hardware level protection chal gayi; display phir E9 ban jata hai.

causes.en: IPM or compressor problem detected by hardware.
causes.ur: Hardware ne IPM ya compressor ka masla pakda.

causes.en: Restart just after stop while the system is not stable.
causes.ur: System stable hone se pehle hi restart kar diya.

solutions.en: Wait a while and start the air conditioner again.
solutions.ur: Thodi der ruk kar air conditioner dobara chalayein.

solutions.en: If it repeats, inspect compressor wiring and replace the IPM.
solutions.ur: Dohraye to compressor ki wiring dekhein aur IPM badlein.

source.title: Sharp AY-X9PSR Service Manual, Ch.6 Chart (protection code)

meaning.en: Supply voltage went outside 160-260V AC, so the unit protected itself.
meaning.ur: Supply voltage 160-260V AC se bahar chala gaya, is liye unit ne khud ko bachaya.

causes.en: Mains sag or surge in the local supply.
causes.ur: Local supply mein voltage ka girna ya surge.

causes.en: Outdoor power source board cannot read the voltage correctly.
causes.ur: Outdoor power source board voltage theek se padh nahi raha.

solutions.en: Test the supply; outside 160-260V AC the unit will trip by design.
solutions.ur: Supply test karein; 160-260V AC se bahar ho to unit design ke mutabik trip karegi.

solutions.en: Test L to N at the outdoor unit as well.
solutions.ur: Outdoor unit par L se N ka voltage bhi test karein.

solutions.en: Replace the outdoor power source board if the supply is normal.
solutions.ur: Supply normal ho to outdoor power source board badlein.

codes.blinkPattern: RUN lamp flashing; TIMER lamp 1 time per 8 sec

source.title: Sharp AY-X9PSR Service Manual, Troubleshooting Guide (Display P1)

meaning.en: Running current exceeded the protection limit.
meaning.ur: Running current protection limit se zyada ho gayi.

causes.en: Outdoor fan motor stopped from overheat or is damaged.
causes.ur: Outdoor fan motor overheat se ruk gaya ya kharab hai.

causes.en: Fan capacitor is damaged.
causes.ur: Fan capacitor kharab hai.

causes.en: Outdoor power source board fault.
causes.ur: Outdoor power source board kharab hai.

solutions.en: Check and replace the fan capacitor.
solutions.ur: Fan capacitor check karke badlein.

solutions.en: Replace the damaged outdoor fan motor.
solutions.ur: Kharab outdoor fan motor badlein.

solutions.en: Replace the outdoor power source board if the fan circuit is fine.
solutions.ur: Fan circuit sahi ho to outdoor power source board badlein.

codes.blinkPattern: RUN lamp flashing; TIMER lamp 2 times per 8 sec

source.title: Sharp AY-X9PSR Service Manual, Troubleshooting Guide (Display P2)

meaning.en: Compressor discharge temperature went too high, so the unit stopped the run.
meaning.ur: Compressor discharge temperature bohat zyada ho gaya, unit ne run rok diya.

causes.en: Outdoor unit air inlet/outlet is blocked.
causes.ur: Outdoor unit ka air inlet/outlet block hai.

causes.en: System is short of refrigerant.
causes.ur: System mein gas kam hai.

causes.en: Exhaust temperature sensor drifted, shorted or open (25C / 20k).
causes.ur: Exhaust temperature sensor drift, short ya open ho gaya (25C / 20k).

solutions.en: Clear anything blocking the outdoor unit airflow.
solutions.ur: Outdoor unit ki hawa ki rukawat hataayein.

solutions.en: Add refrigerant if the system is short.
solutions.ur: System kam ho to gas bharayein.

solutions.en: Replace the exhaust temperature sensor, then the outdoor control board.
solutions.ur: Exhaust temperature sensor badlein, phir outdoor control board badlein.

codes.blinkPattern: RUN lamp flashing; TIMER lamp 4 times per 8 sec

source.title: Sharp AY-X9PSR Service Manual, Troubleshooting Guide (Display P4)

meaning.en: Subcooling went out of the allowed band while cooling, so protection stopped the unit.
meaning.ur: Cooling ke dauran allowed band se bahar subcooling ho gayi, protection ne unit rok di.

causes.en: Indoor unit air inlet/outlet is blocked.
causes.ur: Indoor unit ka air inlet/outlet block hai.

causes.en: Refrigerant shortage.
causes.ur: Gas kam hai.

causes.en: Exhaust or room/pipe sensor drifted (25C / 5k).
causes.ur: Exhaust ya room/pipe sensor drift ho gaya (25C / 5k).

solutions.en: Clear the indoor unit airflow path.
solutions.ur: Indoor unit ka hawa ka raasta kholein.

solutions.en: Add refrigerant to the specified charge.
solutions.ur: Murawwat ke mutabik gas bharayein.

solutions.en: Replace the room (IRT) and indoor pipe (IPT) sensors if readings are off.
solutions.ur: Reading ghalat ho to room (IRT) aur indoor pipe (IPT) sensors badlein.

codes.blinkPattern: RUN lamp bright; TIMER lamp 5 times per 8 sec

source.title: Sharp AY-X9PSR Service Manual, Troubleshooting Guide (Display P5)

meaning.en: The unit overheated while cooling and stopped to protect itself.
meaning.ur: Cooling ke dauran unit overheat ho gayi aur khud ko bachane ke liye ruk gayi.

causes.en: Outdoor airflow blocked.
causes.ur: Outdoor ki hawa block hai.

causes.en: Refrigerant shortage.
causes.ur: Gas kam hai.

causes.en: Outdoor coil temperature sensor drifted, shorted or open (25C / 5k).
causes.ur: Outdoor coil temperature sensor drift, short ya open ho gaya (25C / 5k).

solutions.en: Clean and clear the outdoor unit airflow.
solutions.ur: Outdoor unit ki hawa saaf karein aur raasta kholein.

solutions.en: Add refrigerant if short.
solutions.ur: Kam ho to gas bharayein.

solutions.en: Replace the outdoor coil temperature sensor if out of spec.
solutions.ur: Spec se bahar ho to outdoor coil temperature sensor badlein.

codes.blinkPattern: RUN lamp bright; TIMER lamp 6 times per 8 sec

source.title: Sharp AY-X9PSR Service Manual, Troubleshooting Guide (Display P6)

meaning.en: The unit overheated while heating and stopped to protect itself.
meaning.ur: Heating ke dauran unit overheat ho gayi aur khud ko bachane ke liye ruk gayi.

causes.en: Outdoor airflow blocked.
causes.ur: Outdoor ki hawa block hai.

causes.en: Refrigerant shortage.
causes.ur: Gas kam hai.

causes.en: Indoor exchange temperature thermistor drifted or open.
causes.ur: Indoor exchange temperature thermistor drift ya open ho gaya.

solutions.en: Clear the outdoor unit airflow.
solutions.ur: Outdoor unit ki hawa kholein.

solutions.en: Add refrigerant if the system is short.
solutions.ur: System kam ho to gas bharayein.

solutions.en: Replace the indoor exchange temperature thermistor (IPT).
solutions.ur: Indoor exchange temperature thermistor (IPT) ko badal dein

codes.blinkPattern: RUN lamp bright; TIMER lamp 7 times per 8 sec

source.title: Sharp AY-X9PSR Service Manual, Troubleshooting Guide (Display P7)

meaning.en: Outside temperature is outside the working range (cooling below about -1C, heating above about 33C).
meaning.ur: Bahar ka temperature working range se bahar hai (cooling mein -1C se neeche, heating mein 33C se upar).

causes.en: Genuine limit reached, protection by design.
causes.ur: Asal limit aa gayi, design ke mutabiq protection hai.

causes.en: Outdoor intake sensor drifted, open or shorted (25C / 5k).
causes.ur: Outdoor intake sensor drift, open ya short ho gaya (25C / 5k).

solutions.en: If the weather is outside the range, no repair is needed.
solutions.ur: Mausam range se bahar ho to koi repair nahi chahiye.

solutions.en: Measure the outdoor intake sensor (CN1) and replace if faulty.
solutions.ur: Outdoor intake sensor (CN1) naapein, kharab ho to badlein.

solutions.en: Replace the outdoor power source board if the sensor is good.
solutions.ur: Sensor sahi ho to outdoor power source board badlein.

codes.blinkPattern: RUN lamp bright; TIMER lamp 8 times per 8 sec

source.title: Sharp AY-X9PSR Service Manual, Troubleshooting Guide (Display P8)

meaning.en: Software drive protection fired, usually right after a restart, and then the display changes to E9.
meaning.ur: Software drive protection chal gayi, aksar restart ke foran baad, phir display E9 ban jata hai.

causes.en: Compressor started immediately after a stop while the system was not stable.
causes.ur: System stable hone se pehle compressor ne foran restart le liya.

causes.en: IPM or compressor connection problem.
causes.ur: IPM ya compressor ki connection ka masla hai.

solutions.en: Wait longer before switching the unit on again and retry.
solutions.ur: Unit ko dobara chalane se pehle thoda intezaar karein aur try karein.

solutions.en: If P9 keeps changing to E9, check compressor wiring and replace the IPM.
solutions.ur: P9 baar baar E9 ban jaye to compressor ki wiring check karein aur IPM badlein.

codes.blinkPattern: RUN lamp flashing; TIMER lamp 9 times per 8 sec

source.title: Sharp AY-X9PSR Service Manual, Troubleshooting Guide (Display P9)
